_doc: Defaults from ORGANIC-OS.md (sections 6.1, 6.2, 6.6, 7.4, 7.7). Edit here, not in code. Credits are Higgsfield credits per finished piece with the cast already built, incl. ~25% retakes, from each adapter's own math at growth-engine/production/STANDARDS.md section 10 prices (16 Oct 2026); a series' first episode adds the adapter's one-off cast cost, and lengths come from STANDARDS.md section 8. Story layer (15 Oct 2026): story_templates, animation_styles and each format's production family (growth-engine/production/STANDARDS.md families) feed the router and the production pipeline (growth-engine/tools/pipeline.py).

B1.label: This problem is real, and it is costing me.

B2.label: It isn't my fault. The real cause is X.

B4.label: This method is how it gets solved.

B5.label: It's better than the alternatives I know.

B6.label: It works for a business like mine.

B7.label: I trust and like these people.

B8.label: The next step is easy, safe and worth doing now.

cta_types._doc: What each cta_type means (ORGANIC-OS 6.2, owner's spec). One organic ask per post that fits the card's job; never a link, price, discount, guarantee or urgency.
cta_types.send: Send it to a business-owner friend or partner.
cta_types.comment: Comment an answer to a question the post asks (not a keyword; a keyword is cta_type keyword).
cta_types.keyword: Comment a keyword that is live in brain.json lead_magnets (StraightScale: ANALIZA).
cta_types.book: Convert job only. Said as the keyword or DM path, never a link, price, discount, guarantee or urgency (StraightScale brand kit 'One path': "comment ANALIZA; the booking button comes in the DM").

stage_mix.note: A hard offer post is a convert-job post about the client's one free offer (brain.json offer.main_offer; StraightScale: the free analysis), with the same limits as every convert post: said as the keyword or DM path, never a link, price, discount, guarantee or urgency. About 3% of output (ORGANIC-OS 1 and 6.2): hard_offer_per_month caps new accounts, hard_offer_share sets the monthly cap for the others. It explains only facts the brain holds: no 'what happens in the analysis' (B8) post while offer.delivers is unknown (StraightScale decision D3).

image_question.note: Weakest format: only a strong self-check question, a real review quote or an announcement.

reel_motion.note: Always voiced (owner rule, 15 Oct 2026); the AI voice means the AI label is on (STANDARDS 7).

reel_quote_broll.note: One H3 shot + voice + captions; measured 25 credits on 15 Oct 2026.

reel_strategist_prop.note: Proven paid winner format; rotate the props. The strategist faces the camera only as a presenter in his clearly staged studio set (the whiteboard), AI label on, never as a client, owner or customer (STANDARDS 7). O30 or O60 (ugc-talking-head-organic.md 4).

reel_ugc_pov.note: A staged POV, never a real customer. Until D1 the AI owner is shown from behind, hands only, at a distance or as stylized animation; AI label on (STANDARDS 7). No confession: that needs real footage.

reel_podcast.note: Needs a real disagreement. C45 only (STANDARDS 8). The hosts are staged presenters, never real owners; until D1 they are shown from behind, at a distance or as stylized animation (STANDARDS 7).

reel_story_narrated.skill: hook-lab + script-lab (organic) + H3 + ElevenLabs; story beats from growth-engine/production/STORY-FORMATS.md
reel_story_narrated.note: Like the 60 s w43 reel. Credits: STORY-FORMATS.md 6.4 (O60 at 45 to 60 s).

reel_animation.note: O60 story (STANDARDS 8) in one locked style; the look bible is built once per series and reused (the first episode adds about 15 credits for the sheets, animation-organic.md 4).

reel_song.note: Judge on sends and follows, not DMs. O30 standalone about 140 to 200, O60 about 250 to 355 (song-organic.md 4).

carousel_opinion.note: Values and contrarian positions from the contrarian vault only.

reel_drama_pov.note: A scene from the buyer's day with 2 to 4 characters, a conflict in the first line, the mechanism as the answer near the end. O60 (STANDARDS 8). AI label on per STANDARDS 7 (D1 decides whether to extend it); characters who could pass as real owners are shown from behind, hands only, at a distance or as stylized animation until D1.

reel_animation_short.note: The lab version: O30 (STANDARDS 8), one character, 2 sequences. Tests a story angle or a new series character before a full reel_animation; the first episode adds about 15 credits for the sheets.

reel_talking_head_real.skill: talking-head-recut + embedded-captions (owner films on a phone)
reel_talking_head_real.note: The owner on camera, script from Script Lab (organic). The strongest trust format once the owner films.

story_templates._doc: Narrative shapes (STORY-FORMATS.md). A Post Card names one in story_template; the format renders it. Beats are the default order; Script Lab structure codes in parentheses. AI people follow STANDARDS 7: until D1, AI owners are shown from behind, hands only, at a distance or as stylized animation. Anecdotes only as clearly framed POV dramatizations ("POV: ..."), never stated as fact; no counts unless the number is in brain.json.

pov_day.name: POV: a day in the buyer's life
beats: cold open on the pain moment, in the buyer's words (0 to 3 s)
the day so far: 2 or 3 accommodations, each a picture
the failed fix and why it failed
the revelation: the hidden cause shown as THE PICTURE, then the mechanism (UMS) in one line
organic CTA (follow for part 2, save, send, comment keyword)

two_days.name: Same morning, two owners
beats: their days diverge on one decision

hidden_villain.name: The problem is a character
beats: the villain (an unanswered message, an ad that brings nothing) speaks from where it lives (on the desk, in the inbox)
it brags about what it costs the owner
the mechanism arrives and the villain loses
hidden_villain.note: Comic, never shaming the owner. Best as a recurring animated series character.

object_speaks.name: An object in the business tells its story
beats: the phone, the calendar or the shop sign introduces itself
what it sees every day (the pains)
the day it saw the change (the mechanism)

overheard.name: Witness or overheard line
beats: a framed POV dramatization ("POV: ..."): someone else noticed, the overheard line
overheard.note: Staged: the witness and the speakers are never a real business by name, and the scene is never told as something that happened. Until D1 the people are seen from behind or at a distance (STANDARDS 7).

confession_pov.name: Owner confession
beats: first person, an edge: what I got wrong
what I saw that changed it (the mechanism)
confession_pov.note: Someone's real story in his own words, with no result he can't show: real footage only (STANDARDS 7). card-check fails it while the brain's face is ai_character or real_footage is false. No AI-person format renders it.

song_day.name: Song of the buyer's day
beats: first sung line by 1 s, the problem sung by 3 s

animation_styles._doc: Locked style blocks for animated story formats. The style name is a look, never a studio's characters, logos or names on screen or in a prompt (VISUAL-QA V24). Sheets and storyboards: Nano Banana 2 until re-test R1 (STANDARDS.md section 1).

claymation.name: Claymation (stop-motion clay)
claymation.block: Handmade claymation stop-motion look: plasticine characters with visible thumbprints and slight tool marks, soft rounded forms, miniature handmade set pieces, warm practical lighting, shallow depth of field like a tabletop set, gentle stop-motion texture.

crochet.name: Crochet / amigurumi
crochet.block: Crochet amigurumi look: characters and props knitted from soft yarn with visible stitches, safety-bead eyes, felt details, a cosy miniature yarn world, soft daylight, shallow depth of field.

family_film_3d.name: 3D family-film style
family_film_3d.block: Polished 3D family-film animation look: expressive stylised characters with large eyes and soft subsurface skin, rounded shapes, warm cinematic lighting with soft bounce, rich but controlled colour, gentle depth of field.
family_film_3d.note: Say "3D family-film animation"; never name or imitate a studio's characters.

storybook_2d.name: 2D hand-drawn storybook style
storybook_2d.block: Classic hand-drawn 2D animation look: clean ink lines, painted watercolour backgrounds, expressive squash-and-stretch poses, warm storybook palette, soft vignette.
storybook_2d.note: Say "hand-drawn 2D storybook animation"; never name or imitate a studio's characters.

lead_magnet_checks._doc: A keyword's resource must pass all five before `live: true` (ORGANIC-OS 8.5). The Conversion Agent records them in brain.json lead_magnets[].checks as true/false; card-check fails a keyword with any false and warns while any is unrecorded.
lead_magnet_checks.main_pain: It answers the avatar's main pain from the demand map, in their words.
lead_magnet_checks.one_thing: It is one specific thing with a name and a shape (a 10-question test, a 1-page checklist), not 'tips' or 'a guide'.
lead_magnet_checks.quick_win: The person can use it within a day and sees something useful, even if they never buy.
lead_magnet_checks.leads_to_offer: Using it shows why the main offer is the next step (it surfaces the problem the offer fixes).
lead_magnet_checks.low_friction: Getting it takes the keyword and at most one question in the DM: no form, no email wall, no link before the button.
